name: pirlo
description: Delegates bulky reading, test runs and searches to cheaper worker CLIs, so the lead agent saves its quota.

interface.shortDescription: Hand bulky reading and test runs to cheaper worker CLIs.
interface.longDescription: The lead agent delegates test runs, long logs, docs and wide searches to a cheaper official CLI (Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code or any CLI) in read-only mode, gets a short answer with path:line references, and logs each delegation locally to estimate the savings.
